description: Junte-se  à minha equipe para este desafio genial, que é criar um software de monitoramento para a saúde dos astronautas! Dentre os membros temos cientistas, fullstack, entusiastas e apenas uma regra clara: fazer destas 48horas de hackathon as mais divertidas de nossas vidas!
summary: H.E.L.I.O.S. is a bilingual health-monitoring software prototype designed to help astronauts track health trends, review medical information, and support autonomy during long-duration space missions.
details:
H.E.L.I.O.S. is a bilingual health-monitoring software prototype designed to support astronaut autonomy during long-duration space missions. It integrates medical histories, laboratory results, physiological trends, and self-reported symptoms into a unified interface, helping astronauts monitor health changes over time.

Our approach combines software engineering, scientific research, and human-centered design. Inspired by NASA's Human Research Program and technologies such as the NASA Analyzer, HELIOS proposes personalized biomarker monitoring, contextual health information, protocol-based alerts, and offline medical record storage. Developed using React, TypeScript, and Tauri, the interface supports English and Brazilian Portuguese.
